meta.name: process:bank_statements
meta.description: 231 (plan stage C, C3b3; DECISIONS 231): an own party's bank statements of a period as a process pack (until C3 the statement package, its own kind of work package): a case makes its statement package from its source (the statements of the party and the period the store has not got yet), a person starts its live run within the package's estimate, and the case is done once a live run is approved.

changelog.note: 231 (U0): what the process is for, shown when a person picks a process to start a case of

231 (C3b5b; the owner's decision of 2026-10-26): the workflows' statements step is the pack's (workflow): its new package gets a case of the pack, and its live run starts within the step's budget as before.
231 (C3b5a): the statement packages wrapped are named by the rule they run by (statements), as a statement package has no kind of its own any more.

231 (C3b4): the statement packages made before the pack wraps: each gets a new case around it (its party and period from the package's scope; the package keeps its id, runs and approvals and becomes the processing step's package).
231 (C3b3): the first version: the document processing step with the statements' maker (process_documents@1) and its tabs: Statements, History.

title: Bank statements
summary: An own party's bank statements for a period, from a folder or chosen files: the statements the store has not got yet are read.
